name: @moodle-agent/agent-kit
description: Generic, domain-agnostic scaffolding for building an agent on top of the Claude Agent SDK: session/options wiring, human-in-the-loop hooks and tools, transcript logging, tool-label formatting, global config, and Claude auth. Extracted from moodle-agent (see its CLAUDE.md for the extraction history). Own repo, own versioning (0.x — API not yet stable); not published to npm yet, consumed by sibling agent repos via a `file:` dependency pointing here.
